Annotation Interface Dimension

@Documented @Retention(SOURCE) @Target({METHOD,PARAMETER,FIELD,LOCAL_VARIABLE,ANNOTATION_TYPE}) public @interface Dimension
Denotes that a numeric parameter, field or method return value is expected to represent a dimension.
